mouthpiece: Trombone-type bowl, Waldhorn-type shank. Diameter to outside of rim 37, diameter to inside of rim 25.9, bowl 20.7, throat 5.5, total length 69.
literature: *Van der Meer 1979: 93; Van der Meer 1982: 84; Huber 1989: 356.
remarks: Immoveable slide stay not original. Moveable slide stay has embossed tendril pattern. Ferrules have ring pattern. Flat bell stay and adjacent sleeve not decorated. Hinge plate on bell pipe with leaf motive and zigzag pattern. The last portion of the bell is a separate piece and has considerable flare, rather like a trumpet. The instrument has undergone many alterations, and the bell end probably did not originally belong to the rest of the instrument. ****Nothing is known of a Nuremberg craftsman of this name. ****The initials “M.I.G.” could stand for “Musikinstrumenten Gesellschaft.”
